name: Digivated Membership
custom_summary: One project spotlight and full News access when it launches. $5 once. No recurring charges.
description:
One membership. More room to stand out.

Digivated Membership is a $5 USD one-time purchase. There are no recurring charges or automatic renewals.

One featured project spotlight

Your membership includes one project spotlight on Digivated. Return to digivated.com/membership, verify your membership with your receipt email or license key, and submit your project using the membership option. We review the project, its image, and its destination before featuring it. Projects must meet the listing rules. Traffic, engagement, and sales are not guaranteed.

Full News access, coming soon

Your membership will include full access to the members-only News section when it launches. News is not available yet. No launch date is promised.

Already purchased something from Digivated?

Your previous purchase keeps its original access and included benefits. You do not need to buy again to open an existing purchase.

Checkout shows applicable taxes and purchase terms. Keep your Gumroad receipt and license key private.
